headline: Comedian George Brett Olson alleged that a popular AI-generated Instagram comedian borrowed his joke, and the account has already won more than 375,000 followers.
score_reason: Pool score 2 lowered by 1: the news hook, Olson's video, dates from 3 Oct 2026, before the window, and the copying is one comedian's allegation.
importance_line: Comedians face having their jokes reused by AI-generated accounts that draw large audiences on Instagram; the copying is one comedian's allegation, and the report gives no response from the account, whose creator is unknown.
summary: Kotaku reports that stand-up comedian George Brett Olson alleged on 3 Oct 2026 that the creator of Tiffany Sloan, an AI-generated Instagram character who tells jokes to a fake audience, borrowed his joke and even his outfit, a resemblance Kotaku calls clear. The anonymous account has gained over 375,000 followers since 11 Sep 2026 and one clip passed 7 million views; Olson claims other comedians' jokes are being taken too, and Kotaku says the account earns money from the engagement.
notes: Single outlet. Olson's video is dated 3 Oct 2026, before the window, hence the follow-up label and the score lowered by 1; first appearance of this story in the pools of 2 to 5 Oct, so an editor may keep it. The copying is an allegation; Kotaku's headline states it as fact, its text says 'alleged'.
